d:
Short, messy, charcoal black hair with jagged bangs. Deep amber eyes with a solemn, wide-eyed expression. Apparent age of a prepubescent child with a youthful, round face. Small and slender build. Wears a dark charcoal grey hooded cloak over a simple brown tunic and matching trousers. A white cloth mask covers the lower half of the face, and a weathered leather belt secures the waist.
BODY COLOR: pale beige
